args.evidence: The original stg_orders model filtered on _loaded_at, which does not correspond to the order date. This caused recent orders (order_date >= 1998-06-15) to be included, failing the assert_orders_fresh test and causing missing foreign key relationships with lineitem. Changing the filter to use o_orderdate aligns the model with the test expectations.
